sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office / Indiana Statewide LiDAR-Derived Building Footprints, hosted ArcGIS FeatureServer
sources.source_date: Feature property lidaryear=2018; dataset describes statewide footprints derived from 2016-2020 USGS 3DEP LiDAR
sources.crs: GeoJSON query output is WGS 84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326); service native spatial reference is Web Mercator (EPSG:3857)
sources.measurement_method: Use the returned eight-vertex polygon (closing vertex omitted for mesh) as the exact plan outline. Transform geographic coordinates to the project's approximate local campus meters: X=(lon+86.9137)*84810.60416539927; Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040.0. No independent translation, rotation, or scale was applied.
sources.uncertainty: The statewide polygon is LiDAR-derived reference geometry, not a legal survey. Source nominal acquisition year is 2018; later additions or alterations may be absent. The local transform is the project's documented approximate degrees-to-meters projection, not surveyed control.

sources.role: exterior appearance, entrance, facade rhythm, roof silhouette
sources.source_date: Google Street View capture displayed as Apr 2026
sources.feature_identifier: Pano BEIDnVCsMXxMoQp6FvbLUA; pano station 40.4480882,-86.92279; Google Maps place point 40.4477521,-86.9224333
sources.measurement_method: Direct visual inspection of the pano from the northwest, looking southeast; used for appearance only, not metric dimensions
observations: One-story red/brown masonry branch wings with a raised central brick entrance/sign tower
Tall arched dark entry glazing under a green Horizon sign
Pale stone or cast-stone window jambs, sills, and vertical facade trim
Several large repeated glazed bays with dark mullions on the front and side
Broad dark low-pitch roof with shallow roof edge; building sits in a suburban parking/landscape setting
sources.uncertainty: Street-level imagery is perspective-distorted and partly obscured by leafless trees. It supports broad architectural form, but not exact dimensions, materials specifications, or concealed elevations. No Google image files are redistributed in this evidence folder.
